_comment: Ill-typed package counts per hunt-tier target (corpus/hunt.json).
Separate from health.json so a hunt refresh cannot rewrite an OSS row:
the OSS file is a CI gate, this one records an ad-hoc bug-hunt tier.
Counts may shrink freely; growth fails the gate. Targets absent here
are gated strictly at 0. Panics are never baselined — they always fail.
